findings.F1: The tested effect is near zero at every horizon, not only at the plan's 10 days: closes below the 200-day SMA were followed by a mean excess return of -0.00005 over 1 day (t -0.10, n 8674), -0.00094 over 5 days (t -0.39, n 1709), -0.0034 over 10 days (t -0.70, n 841, 52.6 % down), -0.0002 over 20 days (t -0.01, n 412) and +0.0058 over 40 days (t +0.26, n 197). The plan did not miss a horizon where the effect shows.
findings.F2: The effect is strongly mixed by period, and the periods cancel in the pooled t. The 10-day excess return after closes below the SMA was -0.0395 in 2018 (t -2.41, n 137), -0.0158 in 2019 (t -1.87, n 136) and -0.0250 in 2022 (t -2.64, n 191). It was +0.0493 in 2020 (t +3.05, n 73), +0.0416 in 2021 (t +1.75, n 66) and +0.0190 in 2023 (t +1.67, n 84). Persistence held in the long bear years and turned into reversal in the recovery years.
findings.F3: The plan's grading runs the wrong way. The deepest quarter of forecasts was followed by +0.0076 over 10 days (t +0.71, 48.8 % down), while the three shallower quarters were followed by -0.0059 to -0.0080 (t -0.66 to -0.84). The step-5 slope of excess return on allocation was -0.0126, not positive.
findings.F4: Across coins the sign is mostly but weakly on the idea's side. Five of six coins had a negative 10-day excess return below the SMA, from -0.0034 (ETH) to -0.0095 (BTC, t -0.95). XRP was +0.0083 (t +0.58), and no coin reached |t| 1.
findings.F5: The 20-day return separates outcomes far more than the SMA does, on the side above the average. When the close was above the 200-day SMA, a positive 20-day return was followed by a 10-day excess return of +0.0207 (t +2.36, n 455), and a negative one by -0.0176 (t -1.91, n 231).
findings.F6: Below the SMA, the fall was larger after a positive 20-day return than after a negative one: -0.0111 (t -1.23, n 234) against -0.0032 (t -0.54, n 455). Together with F5, the short-term move matters more than the distance below the average.
findings.F7: The book lost money: Sharpe -0.43 against holding's +0.57 (difference -0.996), mean daily return -0.00027 and Calmar -0.16.

ideas.idea: A coin whose close sits below its 200-day simple moving average keeps falling beyond its usual drift over the next 10 days, the more so the further below it sits, only while its 200-day average has itself been falling over the past 20 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would short closes below the long average only while that average is declining, and refuse the short in recoveries, when the average has turned up.
ideas.name: below-SMA persistence in downtrends

ideas.idea: A coin whose close is above its 200-day simple moving average rises beyond its usual drift over the next 10 days, the more so the larger its 20-day return.
ideas.consequence: A trader would size longs above the long average by the strength of the recent 20-day rise rather than by the cross itself.
ideas.name: 20-day momentum above SMA
